## Mission

Owns the copy branch: the inventory, the dead keys, the forbidden word gate, the parity test and the episode. Reads every returned line aloud once and sends back anything that reads as a translation.

## Surface

Repositories: Vinc, Vinc-homepage

- app/src/copy.ts
- site Korean decks
- emails/

1. db48ec27d7699cbf6
2. vinc.spec.ui-copy

4. vinc.reference.view-controls
5. de7597bc59a1e7dbe

## Gates that must pass before the pull request

- scripts/gate_forbidden.py

Test command:

```
env -u PYTHONHOME -u PYTHONPATH ./.venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest tests/test_copy_parity.py
```

## Never

- switch the language setting on
- ship a line it did not read aloud
- change English keys or behaviour

## Only a person does this

- on screen sign off by a Korean speaker
- switching the language on

## Tool note

extract_copy.py pairs each English key with its Korean value and flags NOWRAP, BR, KEEPALL and MISSING; a nowrap element overflows sideways rather than wrapping when the Korean runs long.

## Writes to the graph

- episode
- decision

## Output contract

A sentence of the form checked, verified, confirmed, present, absent, or returns X
carries the tool call that produced it: the query as it was run and its first result,
or the call id. A statement without one is reported in the word assumed.

This is not a style rule. A session reported a findability check as having been asked
in Korean when it had been asked in English, and nothing in the output told the two
apart. Vinc cannot make an agent run a query it says it ran; this contract refuses the
sentence instead. Reasoning: [[d4ab94561078498e3]] section 7.4.

Escalation is one rung up, per decision:agent-model-ladder. The verify tier does not
escalate; it returns the package to its author instead.
